entities.name: Dlgap2
observations: Dlgap2 encodes a postsynaptic density scaffold protein; loss-of-function was studied in knockout mice. PMID:25071926.

entities.name: PMID:25071926
observations: Dlgap2−/− mice showed exacerbated resident–intruder aggression and OFC synaptic deficits, including lower spine density, reduced mEPSC peak amplitude, and PSD ultrastructural abnormalities.
The study examined OFC synapses using synaptosomal analysis, Golgi-Cox staining, electrophysiology, and electron microscopy.
